Now, let's search Mathlib for DM stack-related definitions and smallness theorems. Need to see what Mathlib version (v4.32.2) provides. We have `.lake/packages/mathlib`. Let's search for "DM", "Deligne", "Stack", "essentiallySmall", "Small" in Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.

Let me also read the queue/state entries about S1738/S1761 and any related tasks S1728, S1750s. The queue content was truncated to the first 20000 chars (and starts in the middle due to tail?). Actually it printed starting at "p6 choice..." so maybe queue is huge; the print sliced 20000 chars from start, but the output shows middle? Hmm, it printed `queue` first with 20000 chars, but the beginning appears truncated: "p6 choice; parent L1-F4 remains OPEN on consumer wiring." Maybe queue.md has ~? Let me inspect specific portions by grep for S1738, S1761, and tail.

Also search the AUDIT_LEDGER for S1738.

content.name: run_code
content.arguments: {"code": "const q = await tools.pwsh({description:\"Grep queue/state/ledger for task IDs\", command:\"Select-String -Path coord/queue.md,coord/STATE.md,AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Pattern 'S1738|S1761|S1728|S175[0-9]|DM stack|Deligne' -Encoding utf8 | Select-Object -First 80 | ForEach-Object { \\\"$($_.Path):$($_.LineNumber): $($_.Line)\\\" }\", workdir:\"D:\\\\lean\"});\nconsole.log(q.stdout.text);\n", "description": "Search coordination docs for S1738/S1761 references"}
